I love the moving story of the old pioneer man who, following his experience crossing the plains, testified: “We suffered beyond anything you can imagine and many died of exposure and starvation, but did you ever hear a survivor of that company utter a word of criticism? Not one of that company ever apostatized or left the Church, because every one of us came through with the absolute knowledge that God lives for we became acquainted with him in our extremities” (in David O. McKay, “Pioneer Women,” Relief Society Magazine, Jan. 1948, 8).
